name: Create a new volume
context:
POST /volumes
Create a new volume
Required: body (body)
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Delete volume
context:
DELETE /volumes/{volumeId}
Delete volume
Required: volumeId (path) — ID of the volume
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Get volume details
context:
GET /volumes/{volumeId}
Get volume details
Required: volumeId (path) — ID of the volume
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Get volume details by name
description: Get volume details by name GET /volumes/by-name/{name}
context:
GET /volumes/by-name/{name}
Get volume details by name
Required: name (path) — Name of the volume
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: List all volumes
context:
GET /volumes
List all volumes
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID; includeDeleted (query) — Include deleted volumes in the response
